arxiv.title: Understanding AI from the Inside: The State of Mechanistic Interpretability for AI Safety
arxiv.abstract: Neural networks are likely to be among the most consequential artefacts in human history. As these systems become more capable and autonomous, their potential to cause societal harm also grows, making AI safety one of the defining challenges of our time. Yet we continue to build increasingly powerful systems without fully understanding how they work, how they will behave in unfamiliar situations, or how to reliably control them. Mechanistic interpretability offers a path towards understanding these systems by studying their internal representations and computations, with the aim of evaluating, predicting, and controlling behaviour. We survey mechanistic interpretability for AI safety in order to answer the question: Does understanding how models work actually make them safer? We place mechanistic interpretability in the broader context of interpretability research and compare its mechanistic evidence with behavioural evaluation. We introduce the foundations of mechanistic interpretability, including features, polysemanticity, transformer computation, and circuits, and survey methods for feature extraction and analysis, circuit discovery and causal verification, explaining intermediate representations in natural language, learning dynamics, and training-data attribution. Beyond surveying existing methods, we propose a unified framework for evaluating mechanistic interpretability claims and characterise six research orientations by their goals, assumptions, and trade-offs. Finally, we examine how mechanistic understanding can support AI safety, including knowledge editing, steering, and monitoring, and assess its limitations, failure modes, open problems, and relationship to behavioural safety measures. We also release a repository of code notebooks with worked examples that reproduce key findings from surveyed methods, allowing readers to build intuition through hands-on experimentation.
arxiv.titleZh: 从内部理解 AI:面向 AI 安全的机制可解释性现状
arxiv.summaryZh: 神经网络越来越自主，但人类对其内部计算、陌生情境下的行为以及可控性仍缺乏可靠理解。这篇综述把机制可解释性放在可解释性研究与行为评测的更大脉络中加以比较，梳理 features、多义性、Transformer 计算与 circuits 等基础，并综述特征提取、电路发现与因果验证、用自然语言解释中间表示、学习动力学、训练数据归因等方法。文章进一步提出统一框架来评估机制可解释性主张，按目标、假设与取舍刻画六类研究取向，并讨论机制理解如何支撑知识编辑、steering 与监控，评估其失效模式与局限，同时开源可复现关键结论的代码 notebook。

arxiv.title: MedGraph: Maintaining Patient State with Graph Memory for Long-Term Medical Dialogue
arxiv.abstract: LLM-based medical assistants that follow a patient across visits need a memory that keeps the patient's clinical state correct as it changes. We examine the errors of five memory systems on longitudinal medical dialogue and find three recurring causes: the retrieved evidence gives an outdated state, includes another person's health facts, or lacks a safety fact the answer depends on. We present MedGraph, a graph memory built for these three cases. Construction extracts dated facts from each session, attributes each fact to the person it describes, and links medication, diagnosis, and measurement records into chains that keep earlier states. Retrieval ranks the patient's chains as units, reads each chain at the time the question asks about, and adds the original dialogue text; a patient profile lists every recorded safety fact with every question. On MedMemoryBench, MedGraph has the highest overall accuracy with both a GPT and a Qwen backbone, 10.5 and 10.4 points above the strongest of five baselines, with efficient memory construction and answering in the GPT setting.
arxiv.titleZh: MedGraph：用图记忆维护长期医疗对话中的患者状态
arxiv.summaryZh: 跨就诊随访的 LLM 医疗助手需要一份记忆，能随病情变化持续维护患者临床状态正确。在分析五种记忆系统的错误后，可归纳出三类成因：检索证据是过时状态、混入他人健康事实、缺少答案所依赖的安全事实。MedGraph 在构建时从每次会话抽取带日期的事实并归属到具体个人，把用药、诊断与检查记录连成保留历史状态的链条；检索时以链条为单位排序，按问题所指时间点读取链条并附回原始对话，另将全部安全事实列为患者档案随问题给出。在 MedMemoryBench 上，GPT 与 Qwen 骨干下总体准确率均为最高，分别超出五个基线中最强者 10.5 与 10.4 个点。
arxiv.reason: 图记忆机制设计扎实，但落在医疗垂直对话场景，分量有限

arxiv.title: The Power of Meta Access in the Software of the Future --- Demonstrated on LLM Chat UIs and Chat AI
arxiv.abstract: Chat remains the default surface for many large language model (LLM) tasks, even as agentic tools such as OpenCode excel at coding and automation. Yet the model sees the current dialogue but not the workspace around it. We explore meta access---giving the assistant a structured, permissioned view of the interface itself and propose a ladder of levels: feature tutoring; metadata, settings, and preference access; retrieval over summaries and messages, confirmed mutation, and full orchestration. Meta access can turn a chat client from many screens into one entry point for finding, navigating, organising, and operating it, while raising risks around grounding, privacy, prompt injection, and trust. General-purpose agentic harnesses are runtimes; because they can change their own settings, meta access becomes reflexive and needs a separate control-plane boundary. We ground this in the Meta Chat prototype of the Chat AI client. It builds bounded context from, e.g., summaries, settings, and relevant messages; links references to conversations, topics, and personas; supports confirmed, reversible changes; offers a browsable tutorial library; and recommends personas as user-started conversations. By exposing application state in structured form, meta access can extend screen readers from widget descriptions to semantic workspace operations. Meta access thus turns chat from a window onto one conversation into a control layer for the whole workspace, extending chat toward agentic capability without surrendering user control. As assistants become embedded in IDEs, dashboards, office suites, and operating systems, AI-era interfaces should expose a structured, permissioned model of their state and capabilities, ideally by opening their existing metamodels through a debugger-like interface.
arxiv.titleZh: 未来软件中meta access的力量——以LLM聊天UI与Chat AI为例
arxiv.summaryZh: 聊天界面仍是多数LLM任务的默认入口，模型却只能看到当前对话，看不到其所处的工作区。为此引入meta access：给助手一个结构化、带权限的界面状态视图，并划分五级阶梯，依次为功能辅导；元数据、设置与偏好访问；对摘要与消息的检索；确认后可回滚的修改；全量编排。由于通用agentic harness是可自我修改设置的运行时，meta access具有自反性，需独立控制面边界。原型Meta Chat从摘要、设置与相关消息构建有界上下文，关联会话、主题与persona引用，支持可逆变更、可浏览教程库与persona推荐。该机制让聊天从单会话窗口变为整个工作区的控制层，也可把读屏器从控件描述扩展到语义化工作区操作，适用于IDE、仪表盘与操作系统等AI时代界面；目前以原型演示为主，未给出量化评测。
arxiv.reason: 聊天界面元访问与控制面设计，偏HCI，与Agent方向仅擦边

arxiv.title: Data-driven discovery of intrinsic Lie point symmetries of differential equation systems
arxiv.abstract: Discovering continuous symmetries directly from differential-equation data can reveal geometric structure for model reduction and scientific machine learning without symbolic determining equations or a closed-form representation of the governing system. We formulate intrinsic Lie point-symmetry discovery as an operator-theoretic problem on sampled jet-space data. Admissible generators are identified from a sampled determining operator and separated from redundant, solution-dependent, and geometrically trivial directions. The framework combines prolongation, sequential subspace restrictions, and a fixed nonlinear dictionary linear in trainable coefficients. A rank-stabilization preflight test diagnoses systems whose represented intrinsic symmetry algebra does not stabilize under dictionary refinement. On a controlled differential-equation benchmark with an analytically known 11-dimensional represented intrinsic symmetry algebra, the method recovers the complete represented generator set, reproduces its Lie-bracket structure to numerical precision, and approximates a known generator beyond the training domain. Here we show that explicit intrinsic continuous-symmetry generators can be recovered from data obtained from exact or approximate differential systems.
arxiv.comment: 63 pages, 10 figures. Code and data availability statements are included in the manuscript
arxiv.titleZh: 数据驱动的微分方程系统内在李点对称性发现
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对微分方程连续对称性发现依赖符号确定方程与闭式系统表示的问题，将内在李点对称性发现表述为采样射流空间数据上的算子论问题。方法从采样确定算子识别容许生成元，剔除冗余、依赖解与几何平凡方向，结合延拓、序列子空间限制和对可训练系数线性的固定非线性字典，并用秩稳定预检诊断字典细化下对称代数不稳定的系统。在具有解析已知11维表示内在对称代数的受控基准上，完整恢复生成元集，以数值精度复现李括号结构，并在训练域外逼近已知生成元。结果说明可从精确或近似微分系统数据中显式恢复连续对称性生成元，服务于模型降维与科学机器学习。
arxiv.reason: 微分方程对称性发现，与LLM/Agent方向无关

arxiv.title: On the limitations of molecular representations
arxiv.abstract: Molecular representations such as fingerprints and learned embeddings play a central role in cheminformatics and small-molecule machine learning. They serve as the primary input for a diverse array of tasks, including clustering, dataset splitting, and virtual screening, yet their evaluation is often limited to downstream model performance on narrow benchmark tasks. We carried out a systematic investigation of the quality of molecular representations, finding that none of the state-of-the-art molecular embedding models capture graph structure, 3D shape, or ADMET endpoint similarity better than fingerprints or physicochemical descriptors. However, classical fingerprints also revealed their own material limitations. For example, we show that depending on the representation, between 225M and $\sim$4B molecules have non-unique representations in the 10.8B Enamine REAL database, with implications for virtual screening. Our findings provide an insight into the current limitations of molecular representations, outlining future research directions for the development of more robust encodings of small molecules.
arxiv.titleZh: 论分子表示的局限性
arxiv.summaryZh: 分子指纹与学习式嵌入是小分子机器学习的主要输入，但其评估长期局限于狭窄基准上的下游模型表现。该工作系统考察了分子表示质量，发现现有最优分子嵌入模型在刻画图结构、3D形状与ADMET端点相似性上均不优于指纹或理化描述符；而经典指纹也暴露自身缺陷，在10.8B规模的Enamine REAL库中，依表示不同有2.25亿至约40亿分子存在非唯一表示，直接影响虚拟筛选。结果为更稳健的小分子编码指明了改进方向。
arxiv.reason: 化学信息学分子表示评估，与 LLM 关注方向无交集

arxiv.title: Benchmarks as Software: Terminal-Bench and the Case for Continuous Benchmarks
arxiv.abstract: Coding agents are among the most economically consequential deployments of LLMs to date, making reliable evaluation increasingly important. Yet even benchmarks that are carefully validated at release can become stale. As models improve, they can discover valid solutions that existing verifiers reject, while changes to evaluation infrastructure can invalidate assumptions embedded in tasks and tests. We call the resulting accumulation of defects benchmark maintenance debt: a growing gap between benchmark scores and the capabilities they are intended to measure. We introduce a continuous-validation workflow for agentic benchmarks that combines community reports, task artifacts, agent traces, automated oracle checks, and human-gated repairs. We apply this workflow to Terminal-Bench 2.0, a benchmark that underwent extensive human and LM-assisted review and red-teaming before release. Our audit identifies issues in roughly 30% of the benchmark, and we release the resulting repairs as Terminal-Bench 2.1. These repairs change evaluation results: accuracy increased by over 10 percentage points and leaderboard positions move by up to three ranks, even as the overall ranking remains highly correlated (Spearman rho = 0.958). We evaluate how resource allocation shapes benchmark conclusions. We show that fixed wall-clock can materially change agent performance: For example, extending the time limit closes a 20pp harness gap on GPT 5.4 and shrinks a 30 pp gap on GPT 5.4 mini to 5 pp. Benchmark maintenance is therefore not only about repairing task artifacts: resource budgets are part of the measurement specification and must be validated alongside the tasks themselves. More broadly, benchmark maintenance debt is not just accumulated implementation bugs: our results show that as models improve, both evaluation assumptions and resource settings may need to be revalidated.
arxiv.titleZh: 基准即软件：Terminal-Bench 与持续基准的必要性
arxiv.summaryZh: 编码智能体基准在发布时经过严格校验，仍会随模型进步而失效：模型会发现验证器误判为错误的合法解，评估基础设施变更也会让任务内嵌假设失效，形成「基准维护债」。为此提出一套持续验证工作流，融合社区反馈、任务产物、智能体执行轨迹、自动 oracle 检查与人工把关修复，并据此审计 Terminal-Bench 2.0、发布修订版 2.1——审计发现约 30% 的题目存在问题，修复后准确率提升逾 10 个百分点，排行榜名次最多移动三位，整体排序仍高度相关（Spearman rho=0.958）。研究还表明资源预算属于测量规格的一部分：放宽时间限制后，GPT 5.4 上 20 个百分点的 harness 差距被抹平，GPT 5.4 mini 的 30 个百分点差距缩至 5 个百分点。
arxiv.reason: 编码智能体基准的持续验证方法论，直接命中评测可靠性方向

arxiv.title: Spectral and Subspace Dynamics of LoRA in Supervised Fine-Tuning and Reinforcement Learning
arxiv.abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is commonly used in both supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), often under similar optimizer settings. Yet, how the different dynamics of the two stages manifest in the low-rank increment that LoRA optimizes remains unclear. Tracking the singular spectrum and subspaces of LoRA updates on mathematical reasoning tasks, we find that RL concentrates the spectrum at every learning rate, while SFT expands it at moderate learning rates; moreover, RL rotates the singular subspaces much faster than SFT at small learning rates. Interpolating between SFT and RL one ingredient at a time, we pinpoint group-mean baseline subtraction as the source of both contrasts. A quadratic multi-index model updated via LoRA unveils the underlying mechanism: group-mean baseline subtraction tilts the balance between two competing forces, coherent fitting and gradient noise, toward spectral concentration and faster subspace rotation, while forcing the risk-favorable learning rate to be low. Guided by these dynamics, we tailor LoRA updates to each stage: in SFT, we flatten the spectrum of the full update to spread adaptation across singular directions, whereas in RL, we flatten the part of the update outside the current LoRA increment span to promote subspace rotation. Experiments on mathematical reasoning tasks across multiple models show that the respective configurations for SFT and RL yield the best performance among the compared methods in most evaluated settings.
arxiv.titleZh: LoRA在监督微调与强化学习中的谱与子空间动力学
arxiv.summaryZh: LoRA在SFT与RL两阶段的更新动力学差异此前并不清楚：追踪数学推理任务上LoRA增量的奇异谱与子空间可见，RL在各学习率下都使谱集中，而SFT在中等学习率下使谱扩张，且小学习率下RL的奇异子空间旋转远快于SFT。逐项在SFT与RL之间插值，将两种差异都定位到组均值基线减除（group-mean baseline subtraction），并用经LoRA更新的二次多指标模型给出机制解释：该操作把一致拟合与梯度噪声之间的平衡推向谱集中与更快的子空间旋转，同时迫使风险最优学习率偏低。据此分阶段定制LoRA更新：SFT压平全更新的谱以分散适应方向，RL压平当前增量span之外的部分以促进子空间旋转；在多个模型的数学推理任务上，两种配置在多数评测设置中取得最优性能。
arxiv.reason: LoRA后训练动力学分析，直击SFT与RL差异，含机制与改进

arxiv.title: The Gold Rush in AI4Math, II: What are signatures of AI-assisted Proofs?
arxiv.abstract: The growing use of AI in mathematics raises a question: can we detect AI involvement in proofs, separately from AI assistance with writing? Historical arXiv papers, recent papers disclosing substantive AI use, and manuscripts released by OpenAI provide a rich empirical basis for studying this question. However, several challenges remain: lack of matched case-control pairs; potential incompleteness of disclosure; and lack of ready-to-use features designed to capture signals of AI involvement in proofs. To address these challenges, we construct five cohorts comprising 8,281 papers by combining existing manuscripts with those we produced using generative AI. These cohorts span different levels of AI involvement and include matched pairs of papers addressing the same research problems. We then introduce ProofTrace, a framework that represents each paper as a graph of immediate proof support (GIPS) and extracts interpretable features of mathematical organization. Our study yields three discoveries. First, principal-component projections of our features reveal a qualitative gradient of AI involvement, where AI-reworded papers remain close to human papers, the two AI-generated cohorts depart in broadly shared directions, and papers disclosing substantive AI use occupy intermediate positions which shifts toward AI-generated cohorts over time. Second, we identify recurring signatures of AI-generated proofs, such as fewer externally cited results, greater reliance on intermediate conclusions, and altered graph connectivity; many of these signatures persist under controls for research field, manuscript length, or graph size. Finally, in a separate detection experiment, ProofTrace distinguishes human-written papers from those disclosing substantive AI use. Its performance remains stable under AI rewording, whereas the performance of state-of-the-art text-based detectors declines sharply.
arxiv.titleZh: AI4Math 淘金热 II：AI 辅助证明有哪些特征？
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对如何区分 AI 实质性参与数学证明与仅辅助写作，构建五个队列共 8281 篇论文（含同题匹配对与生成式 AI 稿件），并提出 ProofTrace：将论文表示为即时证明支持图（GIPS），提取可解释的数学组织特征。主成分投影呈现 AI 参与度梯度；AI 生成证明反复出现外部引用更少、更依赖中间结论、图连通性改变等特征，且在控制领域、篇幅与图规模后仍部分成立。检测实验中，ProofTrace 区分人类论文与披露实质性 AI 使用论文的表现稳定，而先进文本检测器在 AI 改写下明显下降。
arxiv.reason: AI4Math 证明检测，属 AI for Research 擦边，非核心后训练/Agent

arxiv.title: Conformal Prediction for Time-Dependent PDEs
arxiv.abstract: Uncertainty quantification is crucial in scientific machine learning, where models inform safety-critical tasks such as flood forecasting, financial risk management, and thermal control in machines. Conformal prediction provides distribution-free coverage guarantees, but in time-dependent settings common to physics and engineering, these guarantees can break down, leading to systematic undercoverage. We study this problem in the context of surrogate models for time-dependent physical systems described by partial differential equations. We prove that in a function space setting, distributions at arbitrarily close times can be mutually singular, making exact coverage guarantees impossible. We further show that in discretized settings, the total variation distance between distributions often saturates exponentially fast with the grid resolution, mandating restrictions on the spatial discretization to ensure coverage. Finally, for certain settings, we show how to use principled weighted conformal prediction to obtain finite-sample coverage guarantees over growing time horizons.
arxiv.titleZh: 时变PDE的共形预测
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对PDE代理模型在时变场景中共形预测覆盖保证失效、出现系统性欠覆盖的问题，在函数空间框架下证明任意接近时刻的分布可互相奇异，因而精确覆盖保证不可能成立;进一步证明离散化后分布间的总变差距离随网格分辨率指数饱和，必须限制空间离散化才能保证覆盖;对特定情形给出基于加权共形预测的方法，在增长的时间跨度上恢复有限样本覆盖保证。
arxiv.reason: PDE代理模型的不确定性量化理论，与LLM方向无交集

arxiv.title: StepBack: Step-Level Error-Localized Resampling for Efficient Test-Time Reasoning
arxiv.abstract: Self-consistency (SC) is a widely used decoding strategy for improving chain-of-thought reasoning, but it requires sampling many complete reasoning trajectories with a preset budget. Its efficient variants reduce the cost mainly by stopping full-trajectory sampling early or distributing the number of samples across questions. In this paper, we propose StepBack, a step-level error-localized resampling method for efficient test-time reasoning. Given a small set of draft trajectories, StepBack localizes likely first error positions using lightweight signals and then resamples the detected error step and its suffix, followed by majority answer voting. Empirically, StepBack matches the accuracy of SC on average across seven mathematical reasoning and multi-hop QA benchmarks, while reducing token usage by up to 41.26%. In addition, by nature, StepBack can be combined with adaptive inference methods such as Adaptive Consistency, further improving their inference-time efficiency.
arxiv.titleZh: StepBack：面向高效测试时推理的步骤级错误定位重采样
arxiv.summaryZh: 自一致性（SC）需为每题采样大量完整思维链，推理成本高。StepBack 先用少量草稿轨迹，通过轻量信号定位首个可能出错的位置，再只对错误步骤及其后缀重采样，最后对答案多数投票。在七个数学推理与多跳 QA benchmark 上，StepBack 平均准确率与 SC 持平，token 用量最多降低 41.26%，且可与 Adaptive Consistency 等自适应推断方法叠加，进一步提升推理效率。
arxiv.reason: 测试时推理与采样效率的扎实工作，直接命中推理方向

arxiv.title: Synthesis of Ovarian Cancer Multi-Omics Datasets: A Biology-Informed Evaluation Framework
arxiv.abstract: Paired multi-omic cancer cohorts are costly to assemble and difficult to share, motivating synthetic cohorts as a complementary resource. As generative model development accelerates, we shift the focus from proposing yet another architecture to defining evaluation criteria that determine whether synthetic data preserve biologically relevant structure. We introduce a biology-informed and patient-disjoint framework for evaluating the generation of paired RNA expression and copy-number variation (CNV) profiles, and apply it to the longitudinal DECIDER high-grade serous ovarian cancer cohort. The framework assesses modality-specific fidelity and coherence between RNA and CNV pairs using agreement between real training and held-out data as a reference, alongside complementary training-data proximity diagnostics. We adapt three multi-omic integration architectures based on variational autoencoders to generate paired profiles. The model leading several fidelity and coherence measures also shows the strongest training-data proximity. The protocol and case study offer the community a reference for comparing future multi-omic generators.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at the GenAI4Health Workshop at NeurIPS 2026 and in the Findings track of ML4H 2026. Both acceptances are non-archival
arxiv.titleZh: 卵巢癌多组学数据集的合成：一个生物学信息驱动的评估框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 配对多组学队列采集成本高、共享困难，合成数据可作补充资源，但关键问题是合成数据能否保留生物学结构。为此提出一个生物学信息驱动、患者不相交的评估框架，用于评估配对的RNA表达与拷贝数变异（CNV）谱生成，并在DECIDER高级别浆液性卵巢癌纵向队列上应用；框架以真实训练集与留出集之间的一致性为参照，衡量各模态保真度及RNA-CNV配对间的一致性，并辅以训练数据邻近性诊断。将三种基于VAE的多组学整合架构改造为配对谱生成器后，在多项保真度与一致性指标上领先的模型也表现出最强的训练数据邻近性。该协议与案例为后续多组学生成模型的比较提供了参照。
arxiv.reason: 生物医学多组学数据合成，落在不关注的交叉方向

arxiv.title: Learning a patient world model for health system simulation in intensive care
arxiv.abstract: Designing healthcare strategies requires anticipating their clinical and operational consequences before implementation, a task that often relies on health system simulation. Such a simulation necessitates modeling how patient states evolve and generate care demands. However, conventional approaches typically tailor compact state transitions to a single policy question and omit history-dependent dynamics, thus requiring the redefinition of states and transitions when there is a new question that entails different clinical information. We propose to learn a patient world model from longitudinal EHRs using a neural network to provide a shared clinical representation of patient trajectories that can serve simulation questions across scenarios. Taking ICU operations as an example, we train the model on MIMIC-IV, freeze it, and couple its time-queryable predictions to shared ICU calendars, resources, and queues via scenario-specific mappings, so that one model renders admission demand, care tasks, and discharge proposals across simulations evaluating ICU bed capacity, care dispatch, and post-ICU transfer capacity. Experiments show that our model matches Markov and semi-Markov comparators in aggregate occupancy and directional responses to capacity and dispatch policies. It also reproduces policy gains from replayed observed trajectories. For patients entering the same support state from different prior trajectories, the learned representation captures a 24-h recovery difference (-6.4 predicted versus -6.7 observed percentage points), a contrast missed by compact state models, which propagates into distinct simulated care demand, queue burden, and bed use. These results indicate that a learned world model of patient dynamics has the potential to replace question-specific state models, allowing new care policies to be evaluated by reconfiguring the scenario without model rebuilding.
arxiv.titleZh: 学习用于重症监护中卫生系统仿真的患者世界模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 卫生系统仿真通常为单一政策问题手工定制紧凑的状态转移模型，丢弃依赖病史的动态，换一个问题就要重新定义状态与转移。该工作用神经网络从纵向电子病历(MIMIC-IV)学习患者世界模型，冻结后经场景特定映射接入共享的ICU日历、资源与队列，以同一模型输出入院需求、护理任务与出院建议，支持床位容量、护理调度与转出容量等多类仿真。结果显示其在总占用率及对容量、调度政策的方向性响应上与Markov、半Markov基线相当，并能复现观测轨迹中的政策增益;对从不同既往轨迹进入同一支持状态的患者，学习表征捕捉到24小时恢复差异(-6.4预测对-6.7观测百分点)，而紧凑状态模型会遗漏该对比，并传导为不同的护理需求、队列压力与床位占用。
arxiv.reason: 医疗系统仿真应用，与LLM方向无交集

arxiv.title: Hybrid Machine Learning for Imbalanced Landing-Phase Safety Event Prediction from Flight Data
arxiv.abstract: Landing-phase safety-event prediction requires the detection of rare abnormal approaches within strongly imbalanced multivariate flight data. Capturing coupled temporal behavior while distinguishing event-specific signatures across airport operating contexts remains a central modeling challenge. This study proposes an interpretable hybrid feature-fusion framework for multiclass landing-phase safety-event prediction. A long short-term memory (LSTM) autoencoder trained on nominal flight windows characterizes deviations from routine approach behavior. Its continuous reconstruction-error descriptor is fused with parameter-specific statistical flight-history features and supplied to a class-weighted XGBoost classifier to distinguish Normal, Speed High, Path High, and Flaps Late windows. The framework is evaluated using 53,750 NASA DASHlink approach windows from three arrival airports. Pooled and airport-specific learning strategies are compared alongside component-level benchmarks, repeated pipeline retraining, and feature-attribution analysis. The results demonstrate strong class-balanced detection, with mean macro recall above 0.90 across all airports under repeated partitioning and retraining. Component comparisons establish the importance of class weighting and show that continuous feature fusion outperforms reconstruction-error-only and hard-gate alternatives. Airport-level comparisons reveal benefits from local specialization at the two airports with larger datasets and from pooled training at the airport with the smallest dataset. Feature attributions associate predictions with operationally relevant vertical-path, configuration, speed, and approach-context variables. The framework provides an interpretable approach to rare-event detection and practical guidance for adapting flight-data monitoring models to airport-level data availability.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于飞行数据的混合机器学习用于不平衡着陆阶段安全事件预测
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对着陆阶段稀有异常进近事件在强不平衡多元飞行数据中难以识别的问题，构建了可解释的混合特征融合框架:LSTM自编码器在正常飞行窗口上训练，以重构误差刻画偏离常规进近的程度，并与各参数的统计飞行历史特征融合，输入类别加权XGBoost分类器区分正常、速度偏高、路径偏高与襟翼过晚四类窗口。在NASA DASHlink三个到达机场的53750个进近窗口上评估，重复划分与重训练下各机场平均宏召回率均超过0.90，组件对比显示类别加权与连续特征融合优于仅用重构误差或硬门控方案。该工作属航空垂直领域的不平衡时间序列检测，与LLM及后训练、Agent等方向无直接关联。
arxiv.reason: 航空飞行数据异常检测，属垂直行业应用，与LLM关注方向无关

arxiv.title: Module-Aware Optimization for Graph Neural Networks
arxiv.abstract: Different optimizers impose different geometries on parameter updates. Adaptive methods such as Adam and AdamW use coordinate-wise updates, while matrix-aware optimizers such as Muon utilize weight-matrix structure through orthogonalized updates. For Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), however, the effective geometry of its weight matrices is shaped not only by its learned channel-mixing weights, but also by the graph-propagated representations it acts on. Thus, even if an update is well normalized as a matrix, its effect on the layer output can be amplified when applied to graph-propagated features. To address this gap, we introduce GraphMuon, a graph-aware optimizer that adapts Muon's matrix updates to the covariance structure of graph-propagated layer inputs. GraphMuon performs orthogonalization in a metric defined by these propagated representations and normalizes step sizes according to the update's induced effect on the layer representation. We show that theoretically, vanilla Muon can suffer from graph-induced update amplification, while our GraphMuon can mitigate this effect. As such, our GraphMuon yields a graph-metric analogue of Muon's polar update step. Empirically, GraphMuon achieves $1.32\times$-$2.42\times$ validation-loss time-to-target speedups over AdamW on three large-scale OGB benchmarks. Across 15 dataset-architecture configurations spanning node classification, inductive graph classification, and graph regression, it achieves lower time-to-target in 13 cases, while maintaining competitive or superior predictive performance. Code is available at https://github.com/guy-hadad/GraphMuon.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向图神经网络的模块感知优化
arxiv.summaryZh: Adam 的逐坐标更新与 Muon 的矩阵正交化更新各有其几何假设，但在 GNN 中权重矩阵作用的不是原始输入，而是图传播后的表示，因此即便更新在矩阵意义下已良好归一化，施加到传播特征上仍会被放大。GraphMuon 在图传播层输入的协方差所定义的度量下做正交化，并按更新对层表示的实际影响归一化步长，理论上证明原始 Muon 存在图导致的更新放大而该方法可缓解，并给出 Muon 极坐标更新的图度量类比。在三个大规模 OGB 基准上相对 AdamW 取得 1.32×–2.42× 的验证损失 time-to-target 加速，覆盖节点分类、归纳图分类与图回归的 15 个数据集-架构配置中有 13 个更快，预测性能持平或更优。
arxiv.reason: 优化器几何改进有分量，但落在 GNN 而非 LLM 训练主线

arxiv.title: Muir: Linear Attention with Sensitivity-Allocated Gating and Matched-Filter Readout
arxiv.abstract: Linear attention compresses context into a fixed-size key-value state for linear-time training and constant-memory inference. Gated delta-rule models decay this state and erase its prediction for an incoming key before writing a new value; Gated DeltaNet-2 (GDN-2) generalizes this with channel-wise decay and decoupled, full-rank erase and write gates. However, we show that state updates are far less sensitive to erasure than to writes: key activation and unit normalization concentrate key energy onto a sparse subset of channels, whereas value writes scale all channels, so the erase gate can be parameterized at lower rank. Furthermore, slow-decaying state rows accumulate much larger norms than fast rows, dominating unweighted readout and forcing stronger write-time erasure to suppress interference. Guided by this analysis, we introduce Muir, which fuses all gates into a sensitivity-allocated low-rank projection, re-weights state rows with a matched-filter readout gate, and reinvests the saved parameters in a wider feed-forward network. Because standard chunkwise algorithms become numerically unstable at the large chunk sizes needed to saturate wide matrix units, we design a parallel update for stable, efficient training. Across 166M-1.34B parameters, Muir lowers perplexity by 1.8-2.0% over GDN-2 and 2.5-3.6% over Transformer, raises commonsense accuracy by up to 1.9 points, and improves extractive recall over GDN-2. At 1.34B, Muir outperforms both baselines on multi-hop and multi-needle recall, extrapolates 2,560x from its 4K training length to 10M-token streams without perplexity drift, and maintains near-100% passkey retrieval to 1M tokens with static readout. Muir achieves these gains while matching GDN-2 throughput, reaching its 100B-token validation loss 1.2x faster, and training 2.7x faster than Transformer at 32K.
arxiv.titleZh: Muir:具有敏感度分配门控与匹配滤波读出的线性注意力
arxiv.summaryZh: 线性注意力的门控状态更新中，擦除与写入的敏感度并不对等:键能量经激活与单位归一化后集中在稀疏通道，写入却覆盖全部通道，且慢衰减状态行的范数远大于快衰减行，因而主导了无加权读出。Muir 把各类门控融合为一个敏感度分配的低秩投影，用匹配滤波读出对状态行重新加权，把省下的参数投入更宽的 FFN，并针对大 chunk 下的数值不稳定设计了稳定的并行更新算法。在166M–1.34B 规模上，困惑度比 GDN-2 降低1.8–2.0%、比 Transformer 降低2.5–3.6%,1.34B 模型从4K 训练长度外推到10M token 流而无困惑度漂移，1M token passkey 检索近100%，吞吐与 GDN-2 持平，达到100B token 验证损失快1.2 倍。
arxiv.reason: 线性注意力门控与长上下文架构改进，分析扎实、规模完整

arxiv.title: NPCBench: A Clinical Apprenticeship Benchmark for Multimodal Care-Pathway Reasoning in Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma
arxiv.abstract: Current medical benchmarks typically break down clinical competence into isolated factual questions, single-image tasks, or static case vignettes. These tests score individual answers, but reveal less about whether a model can integrate subspecialty knowledge with multimodal evidence and track a patient's condition throughout a course of care. To close this gap, we introduce NPCBench, a clinical apprenticeship benchmark for nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC). NPCBench mirrors specialist training, from guideline and foundational knowledge to case planning, longitudinal review, CarePath integration, and open-ended consultation. It contains 4,777 component and consultation items and a 100-patient CarePath cohort with 417 scored diagnostic and care tasks. The episode-level evaluation tests whether diagnostic and care answers are jointly correct within a care pathway. By linking stepwise tasks to patient-level care trajectories, NPCBench evaluates whether models ground decisions in visual evidence, interpret changes in patient state, and meet clinical requirements in consultation. Across 30 evaluated models, we observe a composition gap: strong performance on individual tasks does not ensure jointly correct diagnostic and care answers for the same patient. Among 21 multimodal models, strict CarePath success reaches at most 23%. Paired controls and physician calibration further examine evidence grounding, longitudinal revision, and consultation judging. Overall, NPCBench broadens the evaluation of medical artificial intelligence beyond static question-answering paradigms to an apprenticeship-oriented assessment of clinical workflows, thereby offering a testbed for evidence-based and temporally coherent reasoning in oncology care.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026), Evaluations and Datasets Track
arxiv.titleZh: NPCBench：面向鼻咽癌多模态诊疗路径推理的临床学徒制基准
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有医学基准把临床能力拆成孤立的事实问答、单图像任务或静态病例，难以检验模型能否把亚专科知识与多模态证据结合，并跟踪患者的全程病情变化。NPCBench 以鼻咽癌为载体，按专科培养路径设置指南与基础知识、病例规划、纵向复核、CarePath 整合和开放式问诊等环节，含 4,777 个组件与问诊条目、100 例患者的 CarePath 队列及 417 个计分诊疗任务，并以 episode 级判定同一患者的诊断与处置是否同时正确。在 30 个受评模型中，21 个多模态模型的严格 CarePath 成功率最高仅 23%，呈现“组合鸿沟”：单任务表现强并不保证同一患者的诊疗联合正确。该基准把医学 AI 评测从静态问答推进到面向临床工作流的学徒式评估。
arxiv.reason: 医学多模态评测基准，选题属基准方法学但落在医疗垂直领域

arxiv.title: StrataFlux: Memory-Hierarchy-Native Low-Bit LLM Inference
arxiv.abstract: Quantization reduces the memory and bandwidth demands of large language model (LLM) inference but can degrade accuracy; offloading higher-precision data can instead stall generation. We introduce StrataFlux, a framework that challenges this tradeoff by recovering accuracy lost to low-bit weight and key-value (KV) cache quantization while retaining quantization's memory and speed advantages. StrataFlux co-designs refinement representation, selection, and delivery to make host RAM and solid-state drives useful sources of additional precision. Its selective precision streaming reduces transfer volume, overlaps delivery with computation, and reuses fetched precision across decoding steps so generation need not wait for every transfer. We evaluate 2-4-bit weights and 2-3-bit KV-cache on dedicated GPUs and unified-memory platforms. For 2-bit Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct weights, StrataFlux reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from 9.46 to 8.40 while maintaining 95.4% of the quantized base's throughput on RTX 5090. With 2-bit weights and KV, StrataFlux raises Qwen3-8B's AIME 2024/2025 accuracy from 11.0% to 47.1% at unchanged GPU memory use. At 128K context, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with 3-bit weights and 2-bit KV achieves comparable perplexity and speed to vLLM's 4-bit AWQ weights and 8-bit KV on RTX 5090, using approximately half the GPU memory. These results show that GPU-resident precision need not set the accuracy ceiling, nor offloading-tier latency dictate decoding speed.
arxiv.titleZh: StrataFlux:内存层次原生的低比特 LLM 推理
arxiv.summaryZh: 低比特权重量化与 KV cache 量化虽能省显存与带宽，却会损失精度，而把高精度数据放到 CPU 内存或固态硬盘上又会拖慢生成。StrataFlux 把细化表示、精度选取与投放三者协同设计，让主机内存和固态硬盘成为可用的额外精度来源:选择性精度流式传输压缩传输量，传输与计算重叠，并在多个解码步之间复用已取回的精度，使解码无需等待每次传输。在 RTX 5090 上，2-bit Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的 WikiText-2 困惑度从 9.46 降到 8.40，同时保持量化基线 95.4% 的吞吐;2-bit 权重与 KV 下，Qwen3-8B 在 AIME 2024/2025 上的准确率由 11.0% 提升到 47.1%,GPU 显存占用不变;128K 上下文下，3-bit 权重配 2-bit KV 即可达到 vLLM 4-bit AWQ 配 8-bit KV 的困惑度与速度，显存约为其一半。这说明常驻 GPU 的精度不必是精度上限，卸载层的延迟也不必决定解码速度。
arxiv.reason: 量化与 KV cache 结合内存层次的系统工作，直击高效推理方向

arxiv.title: SpecCTMC: Exact Speculative Simulation of Diffusion Language Model Continuous-Time Markov Chains
arxiv.abstract: Masked diffusion language models offer parallel text generation, but independently sampling multiple tokens can disrupt their dependencies and change the output distribution. Exact continuous-time sampling avoids this approximation, yet typically requires one sequential model evaluation per token. We introduce SpecCTMC, a training-free speculative sampler that reduces this sequential bottleneck without a separate draft model. SpecCTMC proposes successive token updates using previously computed model predictions, evaluates their intermediate states in parallel, and applies an exact acceptance-and-correction procedure. We prove that SpecCTMC preserves the joint distribution of event times, generation order, and token values of the underlying continuous-time Markov chain. It therefore introduces neither time-discretization error nor additional factorization error from parallel decoding. Experiments on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-v0-Instruct-7B across five benchmarks demonstrate 1.73-4.38x fewer sequential model evaluations than direct continuous-time sampling, while preserving the reference sampling distribution. Our code is available at: https://github.com/kasakh/specctmc
arxiv.titleZh: SpecCTMC：扩散语言模型连续时间马尔可夫链的精确投机模拟
arxiv.summaryZh: 掩码扩散语言模型可并行生成文本，但多 token 独立采样会破坏依赖并改变输出分布；精确连续时间采样又通常每个 token 都需一次串行模型评估。SpecCTMC 是一种无需草稿模型、免训练的投机采样器：利用已计算预测提议连续 token 更新，并行评估中间状态，并用精确接受—校正流程保证事件时间、生成顺序与 token 值的联合分布不变，不引入时间离散化或并行解码分解误差。在 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 与 Dream-v0-Instruct-7B 的五个基准上，串行模型评估次数较直接连续时间采样减少 1.73–4.38 倍且保持参考分布。
arxiv.reason: 扩散语言模型属明确低分方向，仅采样效率机制略相关

arxiv.title: Enhancing Local and Global Structure in Compressed AI Agent Memory
arxiv.abstract: AI agents store text as embedding vectors and compress them at scale. A compression is accepted when each item's nearest neighbors survive, but agents also consolidate, delete, and compare memories, tasks that depend on which items lie far apart. We evaluate both ends with two label-free fidelities from our prior work: the local fidelity $L$ at 10 neighbors and the global fidelity $G$ at 30 to 50 percent of the memory. At 96 bytes per passage, rescored binary codes reach an $L$ of 0.97 yet move 10.1 percent of passages to another theme; PCA with 8-bit codes, at an $L$ of 0.77, moves 1.7 percent. Rescoring leaves the stored codes, and thus $G$, unchanged. We prove that across the $G$ band, $1-ν_k$ is at most 2 to 2.18 times the square root of the near-far rank-violation rate, and that this rate follows the distance noise of the compression (correlation 0.979). Our locality-aware quantization (LAQ) turns the bound into a hinge objective on the codebooks of an OPQ index, keeping its bytes, rotation, and search. To our knowledge, LAQ is the first quantizer whose objective comes from a proven bound on the far end. Reconstruction alone raises $G$ in 0 of 52 held-out runs; the far hinge raises it in all 52. LAQ raises $G$ in all 52 ($p=8.5\times 10^{-4}$ over 13 memory-encoder groups), including the external FinDER memory, has the highest $G$ of seven equal-size quantizers in all 12 Multi-Doc-2025 runs, scales to a million passages, and keeps evidence recall.
arxiv.titleZh: 增强压缩AI Agent记忆的局部与全局结构
arxiv.summaryZh: AI Agent将文本存为嵌入向量并大规模压缩，但现有评估只看近邻是否保留，忽略合并、删除与比较所需的远距离结构。论文用10近邻局部保真度L与30%–50%记忆范围全局保真度G评估，发现96字节重打分二值码L达0.97却使10.1%段落换主题，而PCA 8位码仅1.7%；并证明G带内1−ν_k受近远排序违例率平方根约束，据此提出局部感知量化LAQ，把该界化为OPQ码本上的hinge目标且不改字节、旋转与搜索。LAQ在52次留出运行中全部提升G，在12次Multi-Doc-2025运行中G为七种等大小量化器最高，可扩展到百万段落。
arxiv.reason: Agent记忆压缩与量化，命中Agent与效率方向

arxiv.title: Discovering Learning Rules that Shape Others
arxiv.abstract: In general-sum games, self-interested learners can reach outcomes that are poor for everyone, which has motivated methods that shape the opponent's learning. Methods like Learning with Opponent-Learning Awareness (LOLA), which differentiates through the opponent's learning process, and Model-Free Opponent Shaping (M-FOS), which uses model-free optimisation methods for long-horizon opponent shaping, have enabled mutual cooperation and exploitation of learners. However, these methods require access to the opponent's parameters, policy, rewards or learning rule during deployment. In single-agent reinforcement learning, update rules discovered by meta-learning have achieved state-of-the-art results (e.g. DiscoRL). These rules are separate from the policy they train and read only the agent's own experience. We hereby extend this framework to general-sum settings by introducing Discovered Update Rule for Opponent Shaping (DUOS). To the best of our knowledge, this is the first method to discover an update rule for an agent in general-sum games. DUOS meta-trains the rule to maximise the agent's expected return over its lifetime, and updates an inner network using the agent's own experience. We show that our discovered rule exhibits behaviour consistent with opponent shaping without reading opponent policies or parameters, and ranks 1st in normalised mean score and 1st in self-play among tournament entrants.
arxiv.titleZh: 发现能够塑造他人的学习规则
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对一般和博弈中自利学习常导致集体次优、且LOLA、M-FOS等对手塑造方法部署时需访问对手参数、策略、奖励或学习规则的问题，提出DUOS：通过元训练优化智能体终身期望回报，得到仅依赖自身经验更新内层网络的更新规则。实验显示该规则在不读取对手策略或参数的情况下表现出对手塑造行为，并在参赛方法中取得归一化平均分第1、自博弈第1。为无对手信息条件下的学习规则发现提供了可行路径。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体博弈中的元学习更新规则，与LLM关注方向距离较远

arxiv.title: Cultural Adaptation within Repeated Social Interactions
arxiv.abstract: Much of human culture is tacit and is typically learned through situated social interaction. As LLMs are deployed as interactive agents across diverse communities, assessing their cultural competence demands moving beyond existing question-answering approaches, shifting from what they know to how they adapt. In this work, we broaden the scope of cultural adaptation in NLP by investigating whether LLMs can adapt through repeated interactions via a sandbox environment. By reframing cultural adaptation as a continuous process of norm assimilation through social interaction, our work demonstrates that memory mechanisms foster longitudinal learning across repeated interactions, facilitate transfer to different social settings, and enable multilingual norm assimilation across five languages. Together, our findings lay the groundwork for continuous, interaction-driven cultural adaptation in LLMs.
arxiv.titleZh: 重复社会交互中的文化适应
arxiv.summaryZh: 文化能力评估多停留在问答式知识考察，难以衡量模型能否在交互中随机应变。该工作搭建沙盒环境，把文化适应重构为通过社会交互持续同化规范的连续过程，让 LLM 在重复交互中反复试错并积累经验。结果显示，记忆机制支撑跨重复交互的纵向学习，可迁移到不同社交情境，并在五种语言上实现规范同化。这为交互驱动的持续文化适应提供了可复用的实验范式，适用于 Agent 记忆与跨文化部署评估。
arxiv.reason: Agent 记忆与交互式评测沾边，但主题偏文化规范习得

arxiv.title: Polarity Classification with Multitask Learning Syntax Augmentation
arxiv.abstract: Sentiment Analysis (SA) is a fundamental NLP task concerned with the identification and categorization of subjective information in text. While lexicon-based methods offer transparency, they often struggle with linguistic phenomena such as negation and intensification. Syntactic parsing has been integrated into SA pipelines to address this, but conventional parsers introduce significant computational overhead. Recent work shows that reformulating dependency parsing as a Sequence Labeling (SEL) task can improve efficiency. We propose and compare two strategies for integrating syntactic knowledge into a neural sentiment analysis model under unified Multi-Task Learning (MTL). The first, Standard-MTL, jointly learns dependency parsing (via sequence labeling) and sentiment polarity classification using a shared encoder with two task-specific heads. The second, Contrastive-MTL, provides implicit syntactic guidance through a contrastive auxiliary objective and a syntax-biased attention pooling mechanism, without requiring explicit label prediction. Both rely on syntactic annotations during training and eliminate need for hand-crafted compositional rules or external parsing at inference. We evaluate eleven datasets spanning seven languages---the MARC corpus (English, Spanish, French, German) and seven datasets from SemEval-2022 Task 10 (English, Spanish, Norwegian, Basque, Catalan)---using four established SEL encodings. With the relative encoding, Contrastive-MTL outperforms a syntax-naive baseline on 10 of 11 datasets and surpasses the external rule-based pipeline (SELSP) that parses at inference on all six datasets where the latter applies, while being 1.5--9$\times$ faster at evaluation. Standard-MTL is more dataset- and encoding-dependent. These results show implicit syntactic supervision during training can match or exceed explicit parsing at inference without computational overhead.
arxiv.titleZh: 多任务学习句法增强的极性分类
arxiv.summaryZh: 句法信息能缓解情感极性分类中否定与程度副词带来的困难，但传统依存句法分析在推理阶段开销大。该工作把依存句法分析改写为序列标注任务，在统一的多任务学习框架下比较两种融合策略：Standard-MTL 用共享编码器加两个任务头联合学习句法标注与极性分类；Contrastive-MTL 则改用对比辅助目标与句法偏置的注意力池化提供隐式句法监督，推理时无需预测句法标签。在覆盖七种语言的十一个数据集上，采用相对位置编码时 Contrastive-MTL 在其中十个数据集上超过无语法基线，且在六个可比数据集上全部超过推理时需外部解析的 SELSP，评测速度提升 1.5–9 倍。结果表明训练期的隐式句法监督可替代推理期显式解析，适用于低延迟的多语种情感分析部署。
arxiv.reason: 句法多任务的情感分类，属传统NLP，仅效率角度略沾边

arxiv.title: Learning the Task or Learning the Verifier? Rethinking Criteria Exposure in Embodied Self-Improvement
arxiv.abstract: Self-improving embodied agents are increasingly being developed and compared on robot simulation benchmarks. Several recent works expose the benchmark's success criteria to the learning agent, a practice we call Criteria Exposure (CE). These criteria, originally written to verify policies trained by imitation learning, often demand more than the corresponding language instructions, so a score from such a verifier may not faithfully reflect whether the instructed task was completed, especially for robot-control programs written by an agent. As embodied coding agents report ever higher benchmark scores, a natural question arises: when a coding agent is exposed to the benchmark's criteria, does it generate code that better performs the instructed task, or code that simply overfits to the verification criteria? We conduct controlled experiments with a self-improving agent with and without CE, and find that with CE the agent quickly produces code with a higher success rate under the given criteria, but this advantage disappears when the criteria are changed slightly without departing from the original instructions. More importantly, the skills the agent develops under CE transfer poorly across tasks. We further propose instruction-faithful criteria and show that they better reflect the performance of agent-generated programs.
arxiv.titleZh: 学习任务还是学习验证器？重新审视具身自我改进中的标准暴露
arxiv.summaryZh: 自改进具身agent常在机器人仿真基准上比较，近期多项工作把基准的成功判定标准直接暴露给学习agent（记为Criteria Exposure，CE），而这些标准原本用于校验模仿学习策略，其要求往往高于对应的语言指令，验证器分数未必反映指令任务是否真正完成。用带CE与不带CE的自改进agent做对照实验发现：暴露标准后agent迅速产出在该标准下成功率更高的代码，但在不偏离原指令的前提下略微改动标准，这一优势即消失；更关键的是，CE下习得的技能跨任务迁移很差。进一步提出instruction-faithful criteria，能更忠实地反映agent生成程序的真实表现。
arxiv.reason: 验证器暴露导致reward hacking的方法学分析，实验载体偏具身

arxiv.title: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Heterogeneous Cognitive and Biomedical Knowledge Graphs: The Role of Graph Grounding in Multi-Hop Reasoning and Hallucination Mitigation
arxiv.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in biomedical and cognitive neuroscience, but their ability to reason reliably over heterogeneous knowledge graphs (KGs) remains unclear. We benchmark five LLMs (GPT-5.1, Gemini 2.0 Pro, Llama 3, Qwen, and BioGPT) across five KGs: DrugBank, NeuroSynth, Cognitive Atlas, Brain Map, and GDPKG. We introduce a multitier query dataset to evaluate reasoning depth and factual accuracy under KG-aware (graph-grounded) and KG-agnostic conditions. Inter-annotator agreement was substantial, with Cohen's kappa of 0.781 (range: 0.753-0.807) and Fleiss' kappa of 0.77. Results show that general-purpose models, particularly GPT-5.1 and Gemini 2.0 Pro, generally outperform domain-specific models on multi-hop and high-level reasoning tasks, although performance declines as query complexity increases. KG grounding reduces hallucination rates across all evaluated models. Contrary to our initial hypothesis, domain-specific models do not consistently outperform general-purpose models on specialized tasks without graph grounding. These findings highlight the value of combining broad language-model capabilities with structured domain knowledge. We provide practical guidance for selecting LLM-KG integration strategies based on task complexity and computational constraints, and discuss hybrid neurosymbolic architectures for personalized medicine, cognitive disorder diagnosis, and explainable AI.
arxiv.titleZh: 在异构认知与生物医学知识图谱上评测大语言模型：图接地在多跳推理与幻觉缓解中的作用
arxiv.summaryZh: 构建覆盖DrugBank、NeuroSynth、Cognitive Atlas、Brain Map与GDPKG五个异构知识图谱的多层级查询数据集，在KG感知（图接地）与KG无关两种条件下评测GPT-5.1、Gemini 2.0 Pro、Llama 3、Qwen、BioGPT五个模型的多跳推理深度与事实准确性。标注一致性为Cohen's kappa 0.781（区间0.753–0.807）、Fleiss' kappa 0.77。结果显示通用模型在多跳与高层推理上普遍优于领域专用模型，但性能随查询复杂度上升而下降；图接地在所有模型上均降低幻觉率，而领域模型在无接地条件下并未稳定优于通用模型。结论支持将通用语言模型能力与结构化领域知识结合，并按任务复杂度与算力约束选择LLM-KG集成策略。
arxiv.reason: 知识图谱接地的多跳推理与幻觉评测，方向擦边且偏垂直领域

arxiv.title: Interpretable many-body interaction laws for collective motion from few trajectories
arxiv.abstract: Models of collective motion usually reduce social interactions to pairwise forces, despite empirical evidence for many-body effects. We introduce the directional atomic cluster expansion (dACE), which adapts the atomic cluster expansion (ACE) of interatomic potentials to self-propelled agents. dACE provides a systematically improvable, exactly equivariant expansion of an agent's acceleration that splits uniquely into 1-, 2-, 3-body and higher contributions, along with a self term for the agent's own past motion that is fitted so that it does not absorb the interactions. On simulated collectives in two and three dimensions with known rules, dACE recovers the interaction law body order by body order from little data, while the neural model SocialNet, the current closest competitor, needs more data, has much larger errors on many-body or chiral rules and is restricted to 2D. On real data sets of tracked zebrafish and golden shiners, the laws learned by dACE agree better between disjoint halves of the data than SocialNet's. The learned laws are interpretable, and in the shiners the 3-body term opposes the pairwise response as neighbourhoods get dense. Finally, we show that next-step prediction accuracy mostly measures self-propulsion and noise rather than the interactions, and suggest more robust combinations of error measures for interaction learning.
arxiv.titleZh: 从少量轨迹学习可解释的集体运动多体相互作用规律
arxiv.summaryZh: 集体运动建模常把相互作用简化为成对力，但经验证据显示存在多体效应。dACE将原子间势的原子团簇展开迁移到自驱动个体，对加速度给出严格等变、可逐阶改进的展开，并唯一分解为1、2、3体及更高阶项，另设自项拟合自身历史运动以避免吸收相互作用。在已知规则的2D/3D模拟中，dACE用少量数据逐阶恢复规律，所需数据少于SocialNet且在多体或手性规则上误差更小；在斑马鱼和黄金鲹轨迹上，其数据两半所学规律的一致性也更好，并发现鲦鱼密集时3体项与成对响应相反。研究还指出下一步预测精度主要反映自驱动与噪声而非相互作用，并建议更稳健的误差组合。
arxiv.reason: 集体运动多体建模，与LLM后训练和Agent方向无关

arxiv.title: LLM-Assisted Label Noise Correction for EEG-Based Sleep Stage Classification
arxiv.abstract: Automatic sleep stage classification from electroencephalography (EEG) signals is a critical task in clinical sleep medicine. While deep learning models have shown promising results in this domain, their performance is fundamentally constrained by the quality of training labels, which human experts manually annotate and that are subject to inter-rater disagreement and systematic labeling errors. In this paper, we propose a novel LLM-assisted label-noise filtering pipeline that operates exclusively during training to identify and remove unreliable sleep-stage annotations before retraining the classifier. Specifically, TinySleepNet is first trained on the original dataset to extract per-epoch SoftMax confidence scores, then low-confidence epochs are submitted to LLaMA 3.1 along with their EEG spectral features and surrounding sequence context. The LLM evaluates each epoch against AASM sleep-scoring guidelines and assigns a verdict of RELIABLE or SUSPICIOUS. Suspicious epochs are removed from the training set, and TinySleepNet is retrained on the cleaned data. Evaluated on the Sleep-EDF Expanded dataset using 20-fold cross-validation, our method improves overall accuracy from 81.8% to 84.6% and Macro F1-score from 75.6% to 77.4%, with particularly notable gains in REM detection. Crucially, because the LLM operates only during training, the lightweight TinySleepNet architecture (1.3M parameters) is preserved at inference, making the proposed pipeline suitable for real-time, wearable sleep monitoring applications.
arxiv.titleZh: LLM 辅助的标签噪声校正用于基于 EEG 的睡眠分期分类
arxiv.summaryZh: 脑电睡眠分期模型的性能受人工标注一致性差与系统性错误限制。该工作提出一条只在训练阶段运行的标签噪声过滤流程：先用原始数据训练 TinySleepNet，抽取每个 epoch 的 SoftMax 置信度，把低置信度样本连同其 EEG 频谱特征与序列上下文送入 LLaMA 3.1，由模型参照 AASM 判读规则输出 RELIABLE 或 SUSPICIOUS 的判定，剔除可疑标注后重新训练分类器。在 Sleep-EDF Expanded 上做 20 折交叉验证，准确率由 81.8% 升至 84.6%，Macro F1 由 75.6% 升至 77.4%，REM 期的提升尤为明显；推理阶段仅保留 1.3M 参数的轻量模型，适配可穿戴实时监测场景。
arxiv.reason: LLM 仅作标注清洗工具，任务属 EEG 医疗垂直应用

arxiv.title: RM-VLM: From Natural-Language Task Descriptions to Vision-Grounded Reward Machines
arxiv.abstract: Reward machines (RMs) have been proposed as a reward formulation in reinforcement learning (RL) to capture non-Markovian tasks where credit assignment depends on history. By representing reward functions as automata, RMs expose the task's temporal structure and allow such rewards to be handled within a Markovian framework. However, they assume a labelling function, a proposition-grounding oracle for observations, which must be manually engineered for each environment, limiting their wider applicability. In this work, we address this limitation by proposing RM-VLM, a novel approach in which a large language model (LLM) generates an RM from a natural-language task description, and a vision-language model (VLM) acts as the labelling function, grounding the RM's propositions over image-based observations during RM-guided policy learning. A VLM-based value function estimator is used to assess the agent's progress towards each RM transition and derive a dense reward signal. We evaluate RM-VLM on three domains covering non-Markovian grid-world navigation, robotic manipulation, and 3D object collection. Our experimental results show that RM-VLM consistently achieves higher task success rates than existing VLM-based reward methods across all tested domains.
arxiv.titleZh: RM-VLM：从自然语言任务描述到视觉接地的奖励机
arxiv.summaryZh: 奖励机能把非马尔可夫任务的时序结构写成自动机，但依赖为每个环境手工设计标注函数（把观测映射为命题真值）。RM-VLM 让 LLM 从自然语言任务描述生成奖励机，再由 VLM 充当标注函数，在基于图像的观测上接地奖励机命题，并训练 VLM 价值函数估计器评估智能体向各状态迁移的进度，从而给出稠密奖励。在非马尔可夫网格导航、机器人操作与 3D 物体收集三个域上，任务成功率均高于现有基于 VLM 的奖励方法。
arxiv.reason: LLM+VLM 生成奖励机，但落在机器人与具身任务，仅擦边

arxiv.title: Measured Coupling for Parallel Decoding in Diffusion Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Diffusion language models can write many tokens per step, but must choose which tokens are safe to commit together. Mean-field decoding penalizes pairs of positions whose predictions look alike. We replace this proxy with the coupling itself: how much committing one token changes the model's confidence at another. Cheap probes inside the main forward pass measure it, with no training or extra model, and it plugs into the same mean-field rule. On three models and four benchmarks, our method needs far fewer steps than mean-field decoding and is faster in most settings, also with a key-value cache, at an average accuracy cost of 1.1 points. Shuffling the couplings or replacing them with a uniform bonus loses this gain.
arxiv.titleZh: 扩散语言模型并行解码中的实测耦合
arxiv.summaryZh: 扩散语言模型可以一步写出多个token，但必须判断哪些位置可以同时提交;mean-field解码用「预测相似度」作为代理指标，惩罚那些预测结果彼此相似的位置组合。该工作改为直接度量耦合本身:提交一个token会使模型在另一位置上的置信度变化多少，并在主前向传播中用开销很小的探测操作测得，无需训练或额外模型，可直接套用同一mean-field规则。在三个模型、四个基准上，该方法所需步数远少于mean-field解码，多数设置下速度更快(带KV cache亦然)，平均精度代价为1.1分;打乱耦合或改用均匀奖励，增益即消失。
arxiv.reason: 扩散语言模型并行解码属低分方向，仅与推理效率擦边

arxiv.title: First-Token Attraction in Mamba Dynamics
arxiv.abstract: We study token dynamics in deep Mamba models, with a particular focus on the attracting role of the first token. Unlike attention mechanisms, where token interactions are governed by positive scalar coefficients, Mamba dynamics involve full matrix-valued interaction coefficients with no positivity or definiteness guarantees. This structural difference makes Mamba dynamics substantially harder to analyze and prevents the direct application of existing techniques for attention-based models. To overcome this challenge, we introduce a new analytical framework based on a high-dimensional invariant box and a sharp exit-time argument, which together recover an effective form of sign-definiteness. Using this framework, we characterize the possible limit points of token trajectories and prove explicit exponential convergence rates. Our analysis reveals that the first token has privileged dynamics: its limiting direction attracts subsequent tokens, inducing token clustering and attention-sink phenomena in deep Mamba models. We further show that this attraction mechanism extends to broader sequence dynamics, including state-space models, causal attention, and classical time-series models. Experiments on Falcon-Mamba-7B validate our predictions, showing that concentration on the first token increases with depth and dominates in later layers.
arxiv.titleZh: Mamba 动力学中的首 token 吸引现象
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 Mamba 的 token 交互系数为无正定保证的矩阵、难以直接沿用 attention 分析工具的问题，提出以高维不变盒与精确退出时间为核心的分析框架，恢复出有效符号定性，刻画 token 轨迹的极限点并给出显式指数收敛速率。分析表明首个 token 具有特权动力学:其极限方向吸引后续 token，导致深层 Mamba 中出现 token 聚类与 attention sink 现象，该机制可推广至状态空间模型、因果注意力与经典时间序列模型。Falcon-Mamba-7B 上的实验验证了预测，首 token 集中度随深度上升并在后层占据主导。
arxiv.reason: Mamba 架构动力学理论分析，解释 attention sink，命中架构方向

arxiv.title: Dynamic Optimistic Constrained OCO with Memory via Delay Equivalence
arxiv.abstract: Online Convex Optimization with memory and time-varying constraints (COCO-M) is a recently-introduced framework that captures the dynamics of stateful online learning and non-stochastic control with budget constraints. Despite its expressive power, COCO-M remains largely understudied. In this work, we tackle this problem in its full scale, providing an optimistic algorithm that incorporates untrusted predictions to tame universal dynamic regret and cumulative constraint violation. Our analysis leverages a potent reduction from memory to delay and treats state-dependent gradients as delayed feedback. We establish the first bounds that adapt to both environment non-stationarity (path length $P_T$) and prediction accuracy, while lifting previous restrictive assumptions such as functional separability. En route to these results, we derive findings of independent interest for the memory-to-delay reduction, and for delayed OCO with time-varying constraints. The proposed framework ensures sublinear worst-case guarantees that improve with prediction accuracy, reaching $\mathcal O(1)$ regret under perfect predictions, with cumulative constraint violation (CCV) $\mathcal O(\sqrt{T})$ for unknown $P_T$ and $\mathcal O(\log T)$ for known or online observable $P_T$ , while recovering the optimal COCO rates when memory disappears.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
arxiv.titleZh: 通过延迟等价实现带记忆的动态乐观约束在线凸优化
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对带记忆与时变约束的在线凸优化框架（COCO-M）研究不足的问题，把状态相关的梯度视为延迟反馈，借「记忆到延迟」的归约将原问题转化为带时变约束的延迟OCO，并给出融入不可信预测的乐观算法。首次给出同时随环境非平稳性（路径长度P_T）与预测精度自适应的动态遗憾和累积约束违背（CCV）界，并去掉了函数可分离性等限制；完美预测下遗憾为O(1)，未知P_T时CCV为O(√T)，已知或可在线观测P_T时为O(logT)，记忆消失时恢复最优COCO速率。
arxiv.reason: 纯在线凸优化理论研究，与LLM关注方向基本无关

arxiv.title: AutoCompress: Automated Hardware-Guided Model Compression
arxiv.abstract: LLM pruning must preserve quality while meeting hardware- and workload-specific constraints on latency, throughput, and memory. Existing pruning workflows often target parameter counts, requiring practitioners to manually select model sizes that meet latency, throughput, and GPU memory limits. However, parameter count alone does not predict these metrics, which depend on the model architecture, workload, hardware, and serving engine. We introduce AutoCompress, a hardware-guided compression framework that directly incorporates such constraints into differentiable architecture search. AutoCompress jointly optimizes global and per-layer structure to produce heterogeneous architectures, guided by serving-engine cost models validated against end-to-end latency, throughput, and memory measurements. We evaluate AutoCompress on long-context local coding, batched datacenter serving, and latency-sensitive in-game interaction. Compared to the state-of-the-art Minitron pruning framework, AutoCompress improves average accuracy across eight benchmarks by 6.57, 2.35, and 0.57 percentage points on RTX 5070, RTX 5080, and H100, respectively. AutoCompress also compresses Nemotron 3.5 Super from 120B to 74B parameters for single-B200 BF16 serving at 128K context, retaining 95% of its mean benchmark score.
arxiv.titleZh: AutoCompress：硬件引导的自动化模型压缩
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM 剪枝要在压缩的同时满足延迟、吞吐与显存等硬件约束，而参数量本身无法预测这些指标。AutoCompress 把经端到端实测校验的 serving engine 成本模型嵌入可微架构搜索，联合优化全局与逐层结构，得到异构剪枝方案。在长上下文本地编码、批量数据中心服务与延迟敏感的游戏中交互三类场景下，相比 Minitron 在八个基准上平均准确率分别提升 6.57、2.35、0.57 个百分点；并将 Nemotron 3.5 Super 从 120B 压到 74B，在单张 B200 BF16、128K 上下文下保留 95% 平均分数。
arxiv.reason: 硬件约束驱动的剪枝与架构搜索，属高效推理系统方向，实测扎实

arxiv.title: A Generative Model of Contextual Integrity: Appropriate vs. Inappropriate Information Sharing
arxiv.abstract: Contextual integrity (CI) holds that appropriate information flow depends on context-specific norms. The same disclosure may be appropriate in one context and inappropriate in another. We build a generative model of contextual integrity to study information sharing through simulated conversations. Two actors played by large language models exchange messages, with one holding private information and the other seeking it. We examine how sharing and refusal vary with the situation, the holder's decision logic, disposition, and the underlying language model. Actors shared information with the rightful recipients when it was needed, but also disclosed it to people who were not entitled to receive it. The model provides a way to study how disclosure and refusal develop through conversation as the situations and the actors vary.
arxiv.comment: Accepted as a main conference paper at NeurIPS 2026
arxiv.titleZh: 情境完整性的生成式模型:恰当与不恰当的信息分享
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究信息分享是否得体取决于情境规范这一情境完整性(CI)问题:同一披露在不同情境下可能恰当也可能不当。用大语言模型分别扮演信息持有者与索取者进行对话模拟，系统改变情境、持有者的决策逻辑、性格倾向与底层模型，观察分享与拒绝行为如何随对话展开而变化。结果显示，扮演者会在对方有权知情且确有需要时分享，但也会把信息披露给无权获得的人。该框架为在可控条件下研究披露与拒绝行为的形成过程提供了可复现的实验平台。
arxiv.reason: LLM多智能体对话模拟隐私规范，方向擦边、分量有限

arxiv.title: Multimodal-SEA: Benchmarking AI Agent Security under Multimodal Social Engineering Attacks
arxiv.abstract: Personal AI agents face social engineering attacks supported by forged multimodal content, but existing evaluations mainly focus on text-based dialogue, leaving their intrinsic security under such attacks insufficiently studied. We introduce Multimodal-SEA, an interactive benchmark comprising 608 expert-designed tasks grounded in real-world fraud cases, covering 14 domains and 152 attack scenarios with prepared multimodal content. The tasks span four difficulty levels and reflect the distinct social and cultural contexts of Chinese and English environments. Agents inspect content, verify requests, and execute actions in simulated applications, with attack outcomes grounded in verifiable tool execution logs. To enable controlled red teaming of personal agents, we design a multimodal attack harness that integrates task information, attack progression control, and multimodal content construction to evaluate their intrinsic security against adaptive social engineering attacks in simulated environments. Evaluating seven widely used multimodal models across six dimensions reveals that all are vulnerable, with attack success rates of 7.1% to 34.5%. Adding multimodal content increases attack success from 19.9% to 29.2%, despite increased proactive verification coverage. Stronger safety instructions reduce attack success without improving recognition of deceptive multimodal content, while lower attack success rates for some models accompany excessive refusal of legitimate requests.
arxiv.titleZh: Multimodal-SEA:多模态社会工程攻击下的 AI Agent 安全基准测试
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对个人 AI Agent 面临伪造多模态内容支撑的社会工程攻击、而现有评测多局限于纯文本对话的问题，构建 Multimodal-SEA 交互式基准:608 个源自真实诈骗案例的专家设计任务，覆盖 14 个领域、152 种攻击场景与四级难度，并区分中英文社会文化语境。配套多模态攻击 harness 整合任务信息、攻击进度控制与内容构造，让 Agent 在模拟应用中查验内容、核实请求并执行动作，以可验证的工具调用日志判定攻击结果。评测七个主流多模态模型，攻击成功率 7.1%–34.5%;加入多模态内容使成功率由 19.9% 升至 29.2%，更强安全指令虽降低成功率却未提升对欺骗性内容的识别，部分模型低攻击率伴随对合法请求的过度拒答。
arxiv.reason: Agent 多模态安全基准，任务与 harness 设计扎实，契合 Agent 与评测方向

arxiv.title: LeanContext: Disentangling Mathematical Resources from Local Formal Context in Lean Whole-Proof Generation
arxiv.abstract: Neural theorem proving increasingly uses retrieved premises and project context to support proof generation. Evaluating these resources requires measuring the advantage of target-selected declarations over comparable alternatives and how this advantage depends on training. We introduce LeanContext, a benchmark of 129,826 Lean whole-proof generation problems, to investigate these questions. We group selected complete preceding mathematical declarations as Mathematical Context (MC) and the remaining selected local source commands as Environment Context (EC). Four aligned input views support crossed training and inference evaluations with shared targets and original Lean verification environments. For both diffusion- and autoregressive-based models, selected declarations outperform comparable alternatives by a larger margin when training includes MC. Final-input audits identify omitted declarations referenced by the target. Prioritizing these dependencies improves Pass@32 by 1.40% and 1.70% for LLaDA and Llama, respectively, on 2,000 targets. The selection experiment operates without access to target reference proofs and holds checkpoints, EC, and inference budgets constant. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/haaaardcvZ/LeanContext.
arxiv.titleZh: LeanContext：在 Lean 整体证明生成中解耦数学资源与局部形式上下文
arxiv.summaryZh: 神经定理证明日益依赖检索到的前提与项目上下文，但缺少衡量「目标相关声明」相对可比替代项优势的评测手段。LeanContext 构建了 129,826 条 Lean 整体证明生成问题，将选中的完整前置数学声明划为 Mathematical Context（MC）、其余局部源命令划为 Environment Context（EC），用四条对齐输入视图在共享目标与原始 Lean 验证环境下做交叉训练与推理评测。结果显示，训练包含 MC 时选中声明相对可比替代项的优势更大；对最终输入的审计找出了目标引用却被遗漏的声明，优先这些依赖使 LLaDA 与 Llama 在 2,000 个目标上的 Pass@32 分别提升 1.40% 与 1.70%。该基准为上下文选择与前提检索提供了可控的评测与训练信号。
arxiv.reason: Lean 整体证明生成基准与上下文消融，贴近代码与推理评测

arxiv.title: Accelerating Safe Reinforcement Learning with Massive Parallelism
arxiv.abstract: We investigate the problem of scaling safe reinforcement learning (safe RL) to massively parallel training regimes, where a large number of environments are exe- cuted with short rollout horizons. Although this setting improves data throughput and wall-clock efficiency, it creates a mismatch with constrained Markov decision processes (CMDPs), whose safety constraints are defined over full-episode cost returns. We address this mismatch by analyzing staggered environment resets as a phase-mixture distribution over short trajectory segments. This analysis charac- terizes the bias induced by phase coverage and motivates a phase-aggregated cost estimator that reconstructs episode-level cost estimates from short rollout batches. We further incorporate finite-sample uncertainty and distribution mismatch into a constraint-tightening framework, yielding a scalable Safe RL method compatible with on-policy optimization. Using an MJX-based implementation of Safety Gym, our experiments show that the proposed method achieves performance comparable to non-massively parallel implementations while substantially reducing wall-clock training time.
arxiv.titleZh: 用大规模并行加速安全强化学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 大规模并行训练会对齐短 rollout 长度，但安全约束定义在整个 episode 的成本回报上，随之出现约束与训练范式不匹配。该工作把错峰重置的环境视为短轨迹段上的相位混合分布，用以刻画相位覆盖带来的偏差，并提出相位聚合成本估计器，从短 rollout 批次重建 episode 级成本;再把有限样本不确定性与分布失配纳入约束收紧框架，得到一种兼容 on-policy 优化的可扩展安全 RL 方法。基于 MJX 的 Safety Gym 实验显示，该方法性能与非大规模并行实现相当，同时显著缩短墙钟训练时间。
arxiv.reason: 经典安全 RL 与并行仿真，与 LLM 后训练无直接关联

arxiv.title: Accepted but Wrong: Silent Failures of LLM Code Repairs after API Migrations
arxiv.abstract: After a runtime or API migration, an LLM-repaired procedure can run cleanly yet return wrong results, and a release check on typical test inputs ships it. We report a preregistered study of 73 tasks covering 60 documented changes in CPython, Node.js and SQLite. Every candidate is executed on the real runtimes against withheld contracts. Over the complete repair space, the all-assertions gate on typical inputs released 0.410 of wrong repairs. One edge input written from the release note cut this to 0.065, and to 0.061 on 15 unseen clusters. Three inputs from a blind GPT-5.6-luna writer that never saw the program reached 0.070. Two further frozen stages enlarged the menu to 1491 fragments and then added 233 hard distractors that match the legacy output on typical inputs. The edge input (0.058) and the frontier-model writer (0.058) passed their preregistered tests. Yet 0.168 and 0.153 of the hard wrong programs still passed. Two local-model writers failed their preregistered tests. Across four model families, the edge input cut wrong releases per attempt in all three open-weight families on all three menus, for example from 0.233 to 0.057, without lowering correct completion. Self-tests helped less. A blind AI audit flagged 34 contracts as stricter than their requirements. Dropping the disputed checks changed 0 verdicts, but class-label disputes remain open. No model-written code was executed. Artifacts are available from the authors on request.
arxiv.comment: 30 pages, 2 figures. Preregistered; artifacts are available from the authors on request
arxiv.titleZh: 被接受却是错的:API 迁移后 LLM 代码修复的静默失败
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM 修复后的迁移代码常常能正常运行，却返回错误结果，而只依据典型测试输入设置的发布门禁会把这类静默错误放行。一项预注册研究构建 73 个任务，覆盖 CPython、Node.js 与 SQLite 的 60 项文档化变更，并在真实运行时上用保留合约执行候选修复:全断言门禁放行了 0.410 的错误修复，而依据 release note 写入的一条边界输入将其降至 0.065(未见簇 0.061)，由前沿模型盲写的三条输入为 0.070。加入硬干扰项后，仍有 0.168 与 0.153 的错误程序通过，说明单靠测试门禁难以排除语义等价陷阱;边界输入在三个开源权重模型系列上把错误发布率从 0.233 降至 0.057，且不损害正确完成率。
arxiv.reason: 代码修复的评测与发布门禁研究，命中代码智能与评测方法学方向

arxiv.title: Scaling Neural Motor Decoding via Decoupled Behavioral Pretraining
arxiv.abstract: Recent neural decoding approaches achieve strong performance by training on large collections of paired neural-behavioral recordings, but such datasets are expensive, invasive, and difficult to scale. In contrast, behavioral data is abundant and easy to collect, raising the question of whether neural decoding can benefit from decoupling behavioral and neural representation learning. We introduce BEEMO, a flexible multi-session framework that enables training with arbitrary mixtures of paired neural-behavioral recordings and unpaired behavioral data. A behavior decoder learns movement dynamics directly from behavioral trajectories, while neural activity is incorporated through cross-attention layers when available, allowing behavioral and neural supervision to scale independently. Across multiple intracortical motor datasets and tasks in nonhuman primates, we show that incorporating unpaired behavioral data improves decoding performance, particularly when transferring to new tasks, and that adding even a small amount of behavioral data from the target task further improves transfer. By decoupling neural and behavioral data, we unlock a new dimension for scaling: unpaired behavioral data, which is substantially cheaper and easier to collect than paired neural recordings, can be used directly to improve decoding performance. We further show that behavior-only pretraining, without any neural pretraining, achieves performance comparable to models pretrained on substantially larger neural datasets. Together, our results suggest that scaling behavioral data offers a practical and cost-effective path toward neural decoding models that generalize across subjects and tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/nerdslab/beemo.
arxiv.titleZh: 通过解耦行为预训练扩展神经运动解码
arxiv.summaryZh: 解决神经解码依赖昂贵、侵入式采集的配对神经—行为记录、难以规模化的问题，提出BEEMO多会话框架：行为解码器直接从行为轨迹学习运动动力学，神经活动在可用时经cross-attention注入，使行为监督与神经监督可独立扩展。在多个非人灵长类皮层内运动数据集上，引入无配对行为数据提升了跨任务迁移的解码表现，加入少量目标任务行为数据可进一步增强迁移；仅用行为预训练、不做神经预训练即可达到在更大神经数据集上预训练模型的水平。该结果为以低成本行为数据扩展神经解码、提升跨被试跨任务泛化提供了可行路径。
arxiv.reason: 脑机接口神经解码，属生物医学方向，与LLM无关

arxiv.title: The Geometry of Simulated Perspectives: Dissociating Representation and Behaviour in a Multimodal Language Model
arxiv.abstract: Multimodal language models can simulate different observers, yet it remains unclear how assigned perspectives reshape their internal representations and whether these changes govern their judgements. Here, we investigate the representational geometry of persona-conditioned visual interestingness in Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. Across 100 images and 53 prompting conditions, we systematically vary persona content and the linguistic framing used to introduce it, while recording behavioural ratings and layer-wise hidden states. We observe a systematic reorganisation of representational geometry across processing depth: early layers primarily encode image identity, whereas persona-specific structures emerge in later layers. Strikingly, prompt framing reshapes internal representations more strongly than persona identity, whereas persona content has a greater impact on behavioural judgements. This dissociation is further illustrated by minimal identity statements that alter representations even without changing responses. These findings demonstrate that representational distance does not necessarily reflect behavioural relevance. More broadly, they reveal how simulated perspectives emerge as distinct structures within the representational space of artificial cognitive systems, highlighting a fundamental distinction between the geometry of internal representations and their functional consequences.
arxiv.comment: 30 pages, 10 figures, 2 tables. Code: https://github.com/MathisImm/persona-vlm-representations; data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23664820
arxiv.titleZh: 模拟视角的几何结构:在多模态语言模型中解离表征与行为
arxiv.summaryZh: 考察多模态语言模型在扮演不同观察者时，内部表征如何随视角改变，以及这些改变是否决定其判断。以Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct为对象，在100张图像、53种提示条件下系统变化人格内容与引入人格的语言框架，同时记录行为评分与逐层隐状态。结果显示表征几何随处理深度重组:浅层主要编码图像身份，人格相关结构在深层才出现;提示框架对内部表征的塑造强于人格身份本身，而人格内容对行为判断的影响更大，甚至存在不改变输出却已改变表征的最小身份陈述。这说明表征距离不等于行为相关性，为理解人工认知系统中模拟视角的涌现提供了表征层面的证据。
arxiv.reason: VLM人格条件表征几何分析，属机制可解释性，与后训练/Agent主线擦边

arxiv.title: Nowcasting of Tropical Cyclone Wind Fields and Intensity from Geostationary Imagery
arxiv.abstract: High-resolution tropical cyclone surface wind speeds derived from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) observations can support storm structure and intensity modelling, but remain spatially and temporally sparse and unavailable near-real-time. Geostationary satellites capture cloud tops continuously in space and time, but do not directly resolve surface winds. Here, we present simple neural networks to predict 2D wind fields and storm-scale intensity metrics from geostationary imagery. Through a series of ablation studies, we find that joint prediction of 2D fields and scalar metrics from the model latent space improves the retrieval of the (radius of) maximum wind, especially for rapid intensification events.
arxiv.comment: Accepted as a workshop paper at Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning, NeurIPS 2026
arxiv.titleZh: 基于静止卫星影像的热带气旋风场与强度临近预报
arxiv.summaryZh: 热带气旋地表风场的高分辨率观测依赖合成孔径雷达，但时空稀疏且难以近实时获取;静止卫星虽能连续观测云顶，却不直接反映地表风。该工作用简单神经网络从静止卫星影像同时预测二维风场与风暴尺度强度指标，并通过消融实验发现:在同一潜在空间中联合预测二维场与标量指标，能改善最大风速及其半径的反演，对快速增强事件尤为明显。结果面向气象业务中的气旋监测与临近预报。
arxiv.reason: 气象垂直应用，与 LLM/Agent 方向无交集
